labs.notes: Cross-cutting hub, recorded thin per CLAUDE.md convention. Initiative Head is Ian Waitz (VP for Research). Six 'Core Research Area Leads' are named, each already a PI in their home department (cross-reference, not duplicated): Paola Cappellaro (Quantum Sensing, also NSE/Physics), Dirk Englund (Quantum Networks, EECS), Aram Harrow (Quantum Algorithms, Physics -- already recorded in mit-physics.json), Pablo Jarillo-Herrero (Materials for Quantum, Physics -- already in mit-physics.json and mit-mrl.json), William Oliver (Quantum Computing, EECS), Vladan Vuletic (Quantum Simulation, Physics -- already in mit-physics.json). A separate 'Faculty Advisory Board' lists additional cross-department faculty (e.g. Moungi Bawendi/Chemistry, Vladimir Bulović/MIT.nano, Netta Engelhardt/Physics) not individually re-recorded here.
